name: Moolre SMS Notifications for WooCommerce
author: moolre

sections.description:
Moolre SMS Notifications plugin allows your WooCommerce store to automatically send SMS messages to customers when:

  • Order status changes (processing, completed, refunded, etc.)
  • New customers register on your site
  • You send bulk SMS notifications to selected customers

Why Moolre SMS?

  • Reliable SMS delivery across all networks in Ghana
  • Competitive SMS pricing with transparent rates
  • Instant delivery with high throughput
  • Dedicated sender IDs for brand recognition
  • Detailed delivery reports

Note

This plugin is optimized for WooCommerce stores in Ghana.

Plugin Features

  • Automated order notifications – Send SMS when order status changes (processing, completed, refunded, pending, on hold, cancelled)
  • Registration alerts – Welcome new customers via SMS
  • Bulk SMS – Send messages to multiple customers at once
  • Custom templates – Personalize messages for different scenarios including:
    • Order processing
    • Order completed
    • Order refunded
    • Order pending
    • Order on hold
    • Order cancelled
    • Customer registration
  • Sender ID customization – Use your brand name as sender

Suggestions / Feature Request

bright@moolre.com / hello@moolre.com

Third Party Service – Terms and Conditions

Moolre is committed to providing reliable SMS communication services for businesses across Ghana. Our SMS gateway integration with WooCommerce has been designed with security and reliability in mind.

We implement robust security measures to protect your data and ensure message delivery. All SMS transmissions are encrypted and we adhere to strict data protection standards.

For more information about our terms of service, please visit https://moolre.com/terms.html.
sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New from the left-hand menu
  2. In the search box type Moolre SMS Notifications for WooCommerce
  3. Click on Install Now when you see the plugin
  4. After installation, click Activate

Setup and Configuration

  1. Go to WordPress Admin > MSWP SMS in the left-hand menu
  2. Configure the following settings:
  • API Key: Enter your Moolre SMS API key from your Moolre dashboard
  • Sender ID: Set your preferred sender name (approved by Moolre)
  • Enable Features: Choose which notifications to activate
  • Status Triggers: Select which order status changes should trigger SMS
  • Message Templates: Customize SMS content for different scenarios
  1. Click Save Settings to apply your configuration
sections.faq:
What Do I Need To Use This Plugin?

  • A Moolre account with SMS services enabled – sign up here
  • An active WooCommerce installation
  • Valid SSL certificate for security

How Do I Get My API Key?

Log in to your Moolre account at https://app.moolre.com and navigate to the SMS section to generate your API key.

Can I Customize the SMS Messages?

Yes! The plugin allows full customization of SMS templates with support for dynamic placeholders like {order_number}, {customer_name}, etc.
